name: Vonage Video API (formerly OpenTok/TokBox)
description: The Vonage Video API provides REST endpoints for managing video sessions, archives, broadcasts, live captions, SIP interconnect, Experience Composer, audio connectors, and account/project management. Formerly known as OpenTok/TokBox.
